description.value: The Wedgewood Hotel & Spa is a family-owned boutique luxury hotel that has anchored downtown Vancouver's entertainment district for over 40 years, situated directly across from Robson Square and the Vancouver Art Gallery. As a distinguished Relais & Châteaux member and Michelin Key property, it offers 83 recently refurbished rooms, suites, and penthouses alongside the award-winning Bacchus Restaurant. The hotel operates a named 'Wedgewood Bicycles' concierge service, signalling cycling is part of its guest offering.
